newsitem.title: UK: Flextech falls after newspaper report.
newsitem.headline: Flextech falls after newspaper report.

text.p: Shares in Flextech Plc fell on Monday after a report in the Sunday Times newspaper highlighted investor doubts over the cable and satellite television company's strategy, dealers said.
Flextech shares dropped 19p to 554p by 0750 GMT in volume of 21,000.

The report said a joint venture to form cable TV packages between Flextech and Mirror Group Plc which would compete with channels offered by British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc was still a long way from being signed.

The newspaper added a possible launch of a pay-per-view service joint venture between Cable and Wireless Communications Plc and BSkyB could undermine the success of any deal between Flextech and Mirror Group.
